question: Find the names of all borderless cards that have rulings and are part of sets with Italian translations. Return only those whose set has a baseSetSize greater than 200, ordered by ruling date (oldest first), and limit to 5 results.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN rulings AS r ON c."XCL_072" = r."XCL_090"
INNER JOIN sets AS s ON c."XCL_063" = s."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN set_translations AS st ON s."XCL_099" = st."XCL_093"
WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'borderless'
  AND st."XCL_092" = 'Italian'
  AND s."XCL_096" > 200
ORDER BY r."XCL_088" ASC
LIMIT 5
